sensors.name: File Exists
sensors.description:
Returns the full path of a file if it exists on the endpoint. Will expand environment variables, and will expand %userprofile%/file or "~/file" to search all user home directories.
Example: C:\Windows\system32\notepad.exe
Supports: Windows, Linux, macOS, Solaris, and AIX.

#!/bin/sh

awk_script='
function hex_to_octal(hex) {
	decimal=hex_to_decimal(hex)
	return sprintf("\\0%03o", decimal)
}

function hex_to_decimal(value, result) {
	for(j=1; j<=length(value); j++) {
		result=(result*16) + HEX[substr(value, j, 1)]
	}
	return(result)
}

function convert(s) {
	while(match(s, /%../)) {
		encoded=substr(s, RSTART, RLENGTH)
		sub(encoded, hex_to_octal(encoded), s)
	}
	return s
}

BEGIN {
	HEX["0"] = 0
	HEX["1"] = 1
	HEX["2"] = 2
	HEX["3"] = 3
	HEX["4"] = 4
	HEX["5"] = 5
	HEX["6"] = 6
	HEX["7"] = 7
	HEX["8"] = 8
	HEX["9"] = 9
	HEX["a"] = 10
	HEX["b"] = 11
	HEX["c"] = 12
	HEX["d"] = 13
	HEX["e"] = 14
	HEX["f"] = 15
	HEX["A"] = 10
	HEX["B"] = 11
	HEX["C"] = 12
	HEX["D"] = 13
	HEX["E"] = 14
	HEX["F"] = 15
}

{
	printf("%s\n", convert($0))
}
'

usable_awk() {
	if found=`command -v nawk`; then
		echo "$found"
		return
	fi

	if [ -x /usr/xpg4/bin/awk ]; then
		echo /usr/xpg4/bin/awk
		return
	fi

	command -v awk
}

utf8decode() {
	awk_bin=`usable_awk`
	printf "%b\n" "`echo "$1" | $awk_bin "$awk_script"`"
}

file=`utf8decode "||file||"`
foundone=0

if echo "$file" | grep -q "^~\/"
then
  # replace home directory with nothing
  file=`echo $file | sed -e 's/~\///'`

  # Read in /etc/passwd to determine home dirs
  while read line
  do
     homedir=`echo $line | cut -d: -f6`
     if [ -r "$homedir/$file" ]
     then
		foundone=1
		echo "File Exists: $homedir/$file"
     fi
  done < /etc/passwd

else
   if [ -r "$file" ]
   then
      foundone=1
      echo "File Exists: $file"
   fi
fi
if [ 1 != "$foundone" ]
then
	echo File does not exist
fi

'========================================
' File Exists
'========================================

Option Explicit

Dim strFilePath : strFilePath = UTF8Decode("||file||") ' c:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe

Dim objWshShell : Set objWshShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Dim objFso : Set objFso = CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject")

Dim intLinesOutput : intLinesOutput = 0

If InStr(LCase(strFilePath),"%userprofile%") > 0 Then
	' checks in every user directory
	' Remove %userprofile% and keep the rest
	strFilePath = Replace(LCase(strFilePath),"%userprofile%","")
	strFilePath = objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strFilePath)

	Dim dicUserPaths : Set dicUserPaths = GetProfileDirectoryMap(False)

	Dim blnFileFound : blnFileFound = False
	Dim strProfilePath : For Each strProfilePath In dicUserPaths.Keys()
		If objFSO.FileExists(strProfilePath&strFilePath) Then
			blnFileFound = True
			WScript.Echo "File Exists: " & strProfilePath & strFilePath
		End If
		
		If intLinesOutput > 100 Then
			WScript.Echo "Warning: Maximum number of output lines (100) reached"
			WScript.Quit
		End If
		
		intLinesOutput = intLinesOutput + 1
	Next
	If blnFileFound = False Then
		WScript.Echo "File does not exist"
	End If
Else
	strFilePath = objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strFilePath)
	Dim strFilePathFixed : strFilePathFixed = FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	
	If objFso.FileExists(strFilePathFixed) Then
		WScript.Echo "File Exists: " & strFilePath
	Else
		WScript.Echo "File does not exist"
	End If
End If

Function UTF8Decode(str)
    Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR
    Dim arraysize
    arraysize = 0
    strLen = Len(str)
    for i = 1 to strLen
        sT = mid(str, i, 1)
        if sT = "%" then
            if i + 2 <= strLen then
                Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1)
                arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2))
                arraysize = arraysize + 1
                i = i + 2
            end if
        else
            Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1)
            arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT)
            arraysize = arraysize + 1
        end if
    next
    depth = 0
    for i = 0 to arraysize - 1
		Dim mybyte
        mybyte = arraylist(i)
        if mybyte and &h80 then
            if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then
                if depth = 0 then
                    Err.Raise 5
                end if
                val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f)
                depth = depth - 1
                if depth = 0 then
                    sR = sR & chrw(val)
                    val = 0
                end if
            elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then
                if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
                val = mybyte and &h1f
                depth = 1
            elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then
                if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
                val = mybyte and &h0f
                depth = 2
            else
                Err.Raise 5
            end if
        else
            if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
            sR = sR & chrw(mybyte)
        end if
    next
    if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
    UTF8Decode = sR
End Function

Function FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	Dim strResult, strSystem32Location, strRestOfPath, strRedirectSystem32Location

	strResult = LCase(strFilePath)
	
	If GetCurrentContextBitness() = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 Then
		strSystem32Location = LCase(objFso.GetSpecialFolder(1))
		If StartsWith(strResult,strSystem32Location) Then
			strRestOfPath = Right(strResult, (Len(strResult) - Len(strSystem32Location)))
			strRedirectSystem32Location = Replace(strSystem32Location, "system32", "sysnative")
			If objFso.FolderExists(strRedirectSystem32Location) Then
				strResult = strRedirectSystem32Location & strRestOfPath
			End If
		End If
	End If

	FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath = strResult
End Function 'FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath

Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_32 = "32_ON_32"
Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 = "32_ON_64"
Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_64_ON_64 = "64_ON_64"

Function GetCurrentContextBitness() 
	GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_32
	If Is64() Then
		Dim objEnv : Set objEnv = objWshShell.Environment("Process")
		
		If objEnv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE") = "AMD64" Then
			GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_64_ON_64
		Else 
			GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64
		End If
	End If
End Function ' GetCurrentContextBitness

Function Is64()
	Is64 = True
	If objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE%") = "x86" Then
		If objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432%") = "%PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432%" Then
			Is64 = False
		End If
	End If
End Function

Function StartsWith(strAStr, strPrefix)
	StartsWith = False
	If Len(strPrefix) <= Len(strAStr) Then
		If Left(strAStr, Len(strPrefix)) = strPrefix Then
			StartsWith = True
		End If
	End If
End Function ' StartsWith

Function UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	Dim strResult, strSystem32Location, strRestOfPath, strRedirectSystem32Location
	
	strResult = LCase(strFilePath)
	
	If GetCurrentContextBitness() = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 Then
		strSystem32Location = LCase(objFso.GetSpecialFolder(1))
		strRedirectSystem32Location = Replace(strSystem32Location,"system32","sysnative")
		
		If StartsWith(strResult, strRedirectSystem32Location) Then
			strRestOfPath = Right(strResult, (Len(strResult) - Len(strRedirectSystem32Location)))
			strResult = strSystem32Location & strRestOfPath
		End If
	End If
	
	UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath = strResult
End Function 'UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath

Function GetProfileDirectoryMap(blnLocalProfilesOnly)
	Const HKLM = &H80000002
	Dim arrSubkeys, strValue
	Dim objReg : Set objReg = Getx64RegistryProvider()
	
	Dim dicDirectories : Set dicDirectories = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
	
	Dim strKeyPath : strKeyPath = "SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList"

	objReg.EnumKey HKLM, strKeyPath, arrSubkeys

	Dim strSubkey : For Each strSubkey In arrSubkeys
		objReg.GetExpandedStringValue HKLM, strKeyPath & "\" & strSubkey, "ProfileImagePath", strValue

		If Not dicDirectories.Exists(strValue) Then
			' check to add if not already in the dictionary
			If blnLocalProfilesOnly Then
				' check that the profile is local
				If InStr(strValue,":") > 0 Then
					' Only add the profile if it contains a colon, meaning its local
					dicDirectories.Add strValue, GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSubkey)
				End If
			Else
				dicDirectories.Add strValue, GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSubkey)
			End If
		End If
	Next

	Set GetProfileDirectoryMap = dicDirectories
End Function 'ListForAllUsers

Function Getx64RegistryProvider
	' Returns the best available registry provider:  32 bit on 32 bit systems, 64 bit on 64 bit systems
	Dim intArchType : intArchType = 64
	If Is64() = False Then intArchType = 32
	
	Dim objCtx : Set objCtx = CreateObject("WbemScripting.SWbemNamedValueSet")
	objCtx.Add "__ProviderArchitecture", intArchType
	Dim objLocator : Set objLocator = CreateObject("Wbemscripting.SWbemLocator")
	Dim objServices : Set objServices = objLocator.ConnectServer("","root\default","","",,,,objCtx)
	Dim objRegProv : Set objRegProv = objServices.Get("StdRegProv")
	
	Set Getx64RegistryProvider = objRegProv
End Function ' Getx64RegistryProvider

Function GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSID)
	GetUserForSIDLocal = False
	
	Const HKLM = &h80000002
	
	On Error Resume Next
	Dim strUserData : strUserData = objWshShell.RegRead("HKEY_USERS\" & strSID & "\Volatile Environment\USERNAME")
	On Error GoTo 0
	If IsNull(strUserData) Or IsEmpty(strUserData) Then
		objReg.GetStringValue HKLM, "SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\hivelist", "\Registry\User\" & strSID, strUserData
		If Not IsNull(strUserData) Then
			' strUserData would look like
			' \Device\HarddiskVolume2\Users\user.name\NTUSER.DAT
			Dim intDatPos : intDatPos = InStr(1, strUserData, "\NTUSER.DAT", vbTextCompare)
			' strip off the dat file
			If intDatPos > 0 Then ' must be in string
				strUserData = Left(strUserData,intDatPos - 1)
				' find last backslash
				Dim intFinalBackslashPos : intFinalBackslashPos = InStrRev(strUserData,"\")
				' get right from that pos
				strUserData = Right(strUserData,Len(strUserData) - intFinalBackslashPos)
				GetUserForSIDLocal = strUserData
			End If
		End If
	Else
		GetUserForSIDLocal = strUserData
	End If
End Function 'GetUserForSIDLocalFunction

metadata.name: com.tanium.ai.usage
metadata.value:
Prefer 'Index - File Exists' over this sensor when available. Index - File Exists uses the file index for faster results and supports richer parameter options. Fall back to this sensor only if Index - File Exists is not installed.

Windows file paths must always be quoted inside bracket parameters. The drive letter colon (e.g., C:) breaks the TQL parser if the parameter value is unquoted. Use the form: File Exists["C:\Windows\System32\notepad.exe"]. Backslashes do not need to be escaped inside quoted parameters — single backslashes work correctly.

file=$(echo "$file" | sed 's/ /\ /g')

remote_paths=($(grep '^//| nfs' /proc/mounts /etc/fstab | cut -d " " -f 2))

is_remote_mounted() {
	for path in "${remote_paths[@]}"; do
		[[ "$1" == "$path"* ]] && return 0
	done
	return 1
}

if [[ $file == ~\/* ]] ; then
	file=$(echo $file | sed -e 's/~\///')
	while read line
	do
		homedir=$(echo $line | cut -d: -f6)
		[[ $(is_remote_mounted $homedir/$file) ]] && continue
		[[ -e "$homedir/$file" ]] && echo "File Exists: $homedir/$file" && \
			exit 0
	done < /etc/passwd
	echo "File does not exist" && exit 0
elif ! is_remote_mounted $file && [[ -e $file ]]; then
	echo "File Exists: $file" && exit 0
else
	echo "File does not exist"
fi

'========================================
' File Exists
'========================================

Option Explicit

Dim strFilePath : strFilePath = UTF8Decode("%2froot%2f%2etanium%2dlldp%2etxt") ' c:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe

Dim objWshShell : Set objWshShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Dim objFso : Set objFso = CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject")

Dim intLinesOutput : intLinesOutput = 0

If InStr(LCase(strFilePath),"%userprofile%") > 0 Then
	' checks in every user directory
	' Remove %userprofile% and keep the rest
	strFilePath = Replace(LCase(strFilePath),"%userprofile%","")
	strFilePath = objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strFilePath)

	Dim dicUserPaths : Set dicUserPaths = GetProfileDirectoryMap(False)

	Dim blnFileFound : blnFileFound = False
	Dim strProfilePath : For Each strProfilePath In dicUserPaths.Keys()
		If objFSO.FileExists(strProfilePath&strFilePath) Then
			blnFileFound = True
			WScript.Echo "File Exists: " & strProfilePath & strFilePath
		End If
		
		If intLinesOutput > 100 Then
			WScript.Echo "Warning: Maximum number of output lines (100) reached"
			WScript.Quit
		End If
		
		intLinesOutput = intLinesOutput + 1
	Next
	If blnFileFound = False Then
		WScript.Echo "File does not exist"
	End If
Else
	strFilePath = objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strFilePath)
	Dim strFilePathFixed : strFilePathFixed = FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	
	If objFso.FileExists(strFilePathFixed) Then
		WScript.Echo "File Exists: " & strFilePath
	Else
		WScript.Echo "File does not exist"
	End If
End If

Function UTF8Decode(str)
    Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR
    Dim arraysize
    arraysize = 0
    strLen = Len(str)
    for i = 1 to strLen
        sT = mid(str, i, 1)
        if sT = "%" then
            if i + 2 <= strLen then
                Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1)
                arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2))
                arraysize = arraysize + 1
                i = i + 2
            end if
        else
            Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1)
            arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT)
            arraysize = arraysize + 1
        end if
    next
    depth = 0
    for i = 0 to arraysize - 1
		Dim mybyte
        mybyte = arraylist(i)
        if mybyte and &h80 then
            if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then
                if depth = 0 then
                    Err.Raise 5
                end if
                val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f)
                depth = depth - 1
                if depth = 0 then
                    sR = sR & chrw(val)
                    val = 0
                end if
            elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then
                if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
                val = mybyte and &h1f
                depth = 1
            elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then
                if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
                val = mybyte and &h0f
                depth = 2
            else
                Err.Raise 5
            end if
        else
            if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
            sR = sR & chrw(mybyte)
        end if
    next
    if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5
    UTF8Decode = sR
End Function

Function FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	Dim strResult, strSystem32Location, strRestOfPath, strRedirectSystem32Location

	strResult = LCase(strFilePath)
	
	If GetCurrentContextBitness() = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 Then
		strSystem32Location = LCase(objFso.GetSpecialFolder(1))
		If StartsWith(strResult,strSystem32Location) Then
			strRestOfPath = Right(strResult, (Len(strResult) - Len(strSystem32Location)))
			strRedirectSystem32Location = Replace(strSystem32Location, "system32", "sysnative")
			If objFso.FolderExists(strRedirectSystem32Location) Then
				strResult = strRedirectSystem32Location & strRestOfPath
			End If
		End If
	End If

	FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath = strResult
End Function 'FixFileSystemRedirectionForPath

Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_32 = "32_ON_32"
Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 = "32_ON_64"
Const GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_64_ON_64 = "64_ON_64"

Function GetCurrentContextBitness() 
	GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_32
	If Is64() Then
		Dim objEnv : Set objEnv = objWshShell.Environment("Process")
		
		If objEnv("PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE") = "AMD64" Then
			GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_64_ON_64
		Else 
			GetCurrentContextBitness = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64
		End If
	End If
End Function ' GetCurrentContextBitness

Function Is64()
	Is64 = True
	If objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE%") = "x86" Then
		If objWshShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432%") = "%PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432%" Then
			Is64 = False
		End If
	End If
End Function

Function StartsWith(strAStr, strPrefix)
	StartsWith = False
	If Len(strPrefix) <= Len(strAStr) Then
		If Left(strAStr, Len(strPrefix)) = strPrefix Then
			StartsWith = True
		End If
	End If
End Function ' StartsWith

Function UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath(strFilePath)
	Dim strResult, strSystem32Location, strRestOfPath, strRedirectSystem32Location
	
	strResult = LCase(strFilePath)
	
	If GetCurrentContextBitness() = GET_CURRENT_CONTEXT_BITNESS_32_ON_64 Then
		strSystem32Location = LCase(objFso.GetSpecialFolder(1))
		strRedirectSystem32Location = Replace(strSystem32Location,"system32","sysnative")
		
		If StartsWith(strResult, strRedirectSystem32Location) Then
			strRestOfPath = Right(strResult, (Len(strResult) - Len(strRedirectSystem32Location)))
			strResult = strSystem32Location & strRestOfPath
		End If
	End If
	
	UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath = strResult
End Function 'UnFixFileSystemRedirectionForPath

Function GetProfileDirectoryMap(blnLocalProfilesOnly)
	Const HKLM = &H80000002
	Dim arrSubkeys, strValue
	Dim objReg : Set objReg = Getx64RegistryProvider()
	
	Dim dicDirectories : Set dicDirectories = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
	
	Dim strKeyPath : strKeyPath = "SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\ProfileList"

	objReg.EnumKey HKLM, strKeyPath, arrSubkeys

	Dim strSubkey : For Each strSubkey In arrSubkeys
		objReg.GetExpandedStringValue HKLM, strKeyPath & "\" & strSubkey, "ProfileImagePath", strValue

		If Not dicDirectories.Exists(strValue) Then
			' check to add if not already in the dictionary
			If blnLocalProfilesOnly Then
				' check that the profile is local
				If InStr(strValue,":") > 0 Then
					' Only add the profile if it contains a colon, meaning its local
					dicDirectories.Add strValue, GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSubkey)
				End If
			Else
				dicDirectories.Add strValue, GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSubkey)
			End If
		End If
	Next

	Set GetProfileDirectoryMap = dicDirectories
End Function 'ListForAllUsers

Function Getx64RegistryProvider
	' Returns the best available registry provider:  32 bit on 32 bit systems, 64 bit on 64 bit systems
	Dim intArchType : intArchType = 64
	If Is64() = False Then intArchType = 32
	
	Dim objCtx : Set objCtx = CreateObject("WbemScripting.SWbemNamedValueSet")
	objCtx.Add "__ProviderArchitecture", intArchType
	Dim objLocator : Set objLocator = CreateObject("Wbemscripting.SWbemLocator")
	Dim objServices : Set objServices = objLocator.ConnectServer("","root\default","","",,,,objCtx)
	Dim objRegProv : Set objRegProv = objServices.Get("StdRegProv")
	
	Set Getx64RegistryProvider = objRegProv
End Function ' Getx64RegistryProvider

Function GetUserForSIDLocal(objReg, strSID)
	GetUserForSIDLocal = False
	
	Const HKLM = &h80000002
	
	On Error Resume Next
	Dim strUserData : strUserData = objWshShell.RegRead("HKEY_USERS\" & strSID & "\Volatile Environment\USERNAME")
	On Error GoTo 0
	If IsNull(strUserData) Or IsEmpty(strUserData) Then
		objReg.GetStringValue HKLM, "SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\hivelist", "\Registry\User\" & strSID, strUserData
		If Not IsNull(strUserData) Then
			' strUserData would look like
			' \Device\HarddiskVolume2\Users\user.name\NTUSER.DAT
			Dim intDatPos : intDatPos = InStr(1, strUserData, "\NTUSER.DAT", vbTextCompare)
			' strip off the dat file
			If intDatPos > 0 Then ' must be in string
				strUserData = Left(strUserData,intDatPos - 1)
				' find last backslash
				Dim intFinalBackslashPos : intFinalBackslashPos = InStrRev(strUserData,"\")
				' get right from that pos
				strUserData = Right(strUserData,Len(strUserData) - intFinalBackslashPos)
				GetUserForSIDLocal = strUserData
			End If
		End If
	Else
		GetUserForSIDLocal = strUserData
	End If
End Function 'GetUserForSIDLocalFunction
